title: json5 prototype pollution in two copies, two majors
description: A project on json5 2.2.1 that also uses tsconfig-paths 3.14.1, whose json5 ^1.0.1 range resolved to 1.0.1 when the lockfile was written in November 2022. The published advisory CVE-2022-46175 covers both copies and is fixed in 1.0.2 and in 2.2.2, so each copy needs the fix of its own major.
